edges.label: uses the app
edges.payload: Clicks, drag-and-drop files, chat messages, Cmd+K queries
edges.details: Works on desktop and phone. Phones get a bottom tab bar.

edges.label: REST + Bearer JWT
edges.payload: JSON, or multipart/form-data for uploads; Authorization: Bearer <access JWT>
edges.details: Sends the refresh cookie along. On a 401 it refreshes once and retries.

edges.label: resolves principal
edges.payload: Bearer credential → Principal{user, auth_type, scopes, key_prefix}
edges.details: Keys starting byosk_ are looked up by prefix. Anything else is treated as a JWT.

edges.label: /auth/* login
edges.details: 20 requests a minute per IP. Hands back an access token and rotates the cookie.

edges.label: send code, sign in
edges.details: A fresh Telethon client per step, restored from the encrypted ticket.

edges.label: users, tokens, keys
edges.details: Account and storage are created in one transaction.

edges.label: files and folders
edges.payload: Calls scoped to the owner, e.g. upload, search, move, verify
edges.details: Every route checks the key's scope and rate limit.

edges.label: /files, /folders
edges.details: Really goes through the gateway. Drawn direct in walkthroughs to save arrows.

edges.label: metadata + search
edges.payload: files, file_versions, folders, tags; recursive CTEs; websearch_to_tsquery + ILIKE
edges.details: An upload's rows and its version pointer land in one commit.

edges.label: upload / download
edges.details: Reads uploads 1 MiB at a time. Errors come back tagged with the account.

edges.label: Saved Messages I/O
edges.details: One pooled client per session. Revoked sessions get kicked out of the pool.

edges.label: release assets
edges.payload: Asset upload to uploads.github.com; asset GET following the redirect
edges.details: Release ids cached per repo and day. A 401 means the token was revoked.

edges.label: put / get object
edges.details: boto3 in worker threads, up to 3 attempts per call.

edges.label: storage_accounts
edges.payload: Encrypted credentials and config; status updates
edges.details: Flags dead storage on its own database session.

edges.label: manage links
edges.payload: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /aliases and /shares; GET /public/... from the folder page
edges.details: API keys need the aliases scope. Public routes are rate-limited per IP.

edges.label: opens a link
edges.details: Returns the file, a 304, a folder redirect, a 404, or 410 once expired.

edges.label: shared folder page
edges.payload: GET /{username}/{slug} on the web app after the API's 302
edges.details: Links that don't exist get the 404 page.

edges.label: resolve links
edges.details: Counts share downloads. A missing object marks the file as missing.

edges.label: stream_object
edges.payload: First chunk fetched before headers, then a StreamingResponse with the hash as ETag
edges.details: If the owner's GitHub or S3 keys broke, the visitor gets a plain 503; a dead Telegram session gives a 409.

edges.label: public rate limit
edges.details: Fixed 60 second window. If Redis fails, requests go through.

edges.label: limits + cache
edges.details: Fails open, so a Redis outage never blocks a request.

edges.label: /ai/agent/*
edges.payload: {conversation_id, key_id, message, mode, strategies, organize?, revises?, fixes?}; plans/{id}/apply|discard
edges.details: Turns off proxy buffering. Control events ride inside the answer text.

edges.label: chat_tools steps
edges.details: Not streamed, because every provider splits tool calls differently. Step-limited per turn.

edges.label: read and write tools
edges.details: Writes use the same functions as the REST API.

edges.label: search_content
edges.details: Same retrieval pipeline as RAG chat, with this turn's add-ons.

edges.label: plans and messages
edges.details: A plan only moves forward: pending, then applied or discarded.

edges.label: /ai/index, /ai/chat
edges.details: Needs a real login. API keys can't start indexing.

edges.label: downloads for extraction
edges.details: Skips files already embedded at their current version.

edges.label: embed / transcribe
edges.payload: Chunks → vectors; page PNGs → text; rewrite, HyDE and rerank prompts
edges.details: Indexing retries each file up to 3 times on rate limits or network errors. The rewrite, HyDE and rerank prompts aren't retried.

edges.label: ai_file_chunks
edges.details: Ranked in SQL by pgvector cosine distance. Only the top k rows leave the database.

edges.label: OpenAI-compatible calls
edges.details: Pooled httpx client. Rejected parameters get adjusted up to 3 times.

edges.label: emit file.*
edges.details: Fire and forget. The upload doesn't wait.

edges.label: loads webhooks
edges.details: Own database session, since the request has already finished.

edges.label: signed POST
edges.details: 5 second timeout, no redirects, no retries.

edges.label: Bearer byosk_ key
edges.details: 120 requests a minute per key. Account-admin routes say 403.

edges.label: GET /ping
edges.details: Every 5 minutes. Never touches the database or auth.

edges.label: GET /
edges.details: Every 5 minutes, just to keep it awake.

edges.label: per-device state
edges.payload: Preferences, recents, chat threads, caches, sounds, PDF canvas
edges.details: Nearly every read and write is wrapped, so private windows mostly still work.

edges.label: /webhooks CRUD
edges.details: Session login only. Internal URLs are rejected. Max 5.
